title: Rubio Casts Doubts On Quick Deal To End War In Ukraine, Defends Russian Contacts
content: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said he was unsure whether a negotiated end to the war in Ukraine was possible, while European officials told RFE/RL the top US diplomat privately expressed doubts that Russian President Vladimir Putin will attend December’s Miami G20 summit.

title: Tears Of Joy As Ukrainians Evacuated From Russian-Occupied Oleshky Reunite With Family
content: After nearly four years under Russian occupation, hundreds of residents from the southern Ukrainian city of Oleshky have arrived in Ukrainian-controlled territory following a cease-fire brokered by US first lady Melania Trump. A convoy of 25 buses helped facilitate the evacuation.

title: Food Lines, War Dead: The Way They Live Now In A Frigid Siberian Town
content: The scene outside Tura's main food store looked like something from the Soviet era: With the mercury at -15 C, residents lined up for hours to pay high prices for staples short supply. The shortages stemmed from geography and negligence, but Russia’s war on Ukraine has taken its toll on the town.

title: Kosovo Protests Grow Over Killing Of Woman Who Pleaded For Police Protection

title: Putin Has Shown No Willingness To End Ukraine War, Says Mike Pompeo

title: 'A Reasonable Price': Inside Iran's Illicit Trade In Babies
content: Intermediaries on Iranian Telegram channels are offering newborns for up to $1,100 under the guise of charity, with some promising to falsify birth records and others arranging placements with Iranian families abroad, despite a ban on the sale of babies.

title: Russian Drone Strikes Railway Station In Dnipro, Killing At Least 14
content: A Russian drone struck a railway station in Dnipro, killing at least 14 people and injuring others, Ukrainian officials said. The attack hit a platform where a passenger train bound for Zaporizhzhya was standing.

title: The Week In Russia: Tensions, Talks, And 'Terror'

title: 'Life On Every Street': Ukrainians In Kherson Welcome Cease-Fire In Nearby Oleshky
content: A US-brokered cease-fire went into effect on October 27 to let aid arrive in the Russian-occupied suburb of Oleshky and allow civilians to leave.
